root.claim: A deterministic fixed-tape machine multiplies $n$-bit integers in $O(n(\lg n)^{1-\kappa})$ time, $\kappa=2^{-182}$.
root.method: reduce multiplication through a chain of representation changes down to ring convolution, using the fast tape procedures, then recover the product

motivation.text: Each reduction changes the problem to one whose transforms have power-of-two axes and polynomial roots of unity, where the fast tape procedures apply.

root.salient: The saving is a strict power $(\lg n)^{-\kappa}$ of the logarithmic factor with a tiny exponent $\kappa=2^{-182}$.
